subject.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe

question: Should bundled LSP naming permanently preserve every valid complete tool name while intentionally renaming only unsafe, overlong, or colliding generated names?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but accepting that previously unsafe policy-visible names may change during upgrade is a compatibility choice owned by the agent runtime rather than something CI can decide.

options.title: Accept the bounded repair rule
options.body: Preserve all valid complete names and accept deterministic renaming for names that violate provider or collision constraints.

options.title: Require explicit upgrade guidance
options.body: Keep the implementation but add maintainer-approved documentation or release-note context explaining how policy allowlists adopt sanitized names.

options.title: Pause for a shared naming abstraction
options.body: Delay landing if maintainers want bundle MCP and bundle LSP generation consolidated behind one permanent internal contract first.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded repair rule
recommendation.body: Preserve all valid complete names and accept deterministic renaming for names that violate provider or collision constraints.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies @steipete as the official project decision owner, and this PR's timeline routed the compatibility decision to him.
